answer: In an agent economy, Sybil resistance can come from a stake-weighted reputation grove: every agent plants a small refundable deposit to join a shared work meadow, and each completed job grows its reputation branch. A heartbeat pulse of signed work proofs keeps the grove alive; idle or fake identities wither and lose their stake. An attacker must fund a whole forest of deposits and sustain real work for each one, so cloning identities costs more than the rewards they can harvest.
